_doc: Deliberate defects. Each is a minimal, uniquely-quoted change to one source line that a specific test node MUST catch (the test FAILS when the defect is applied and PASSES on clean code). A suite nobody has broken on purpose is not evidence. `covers` lists the correctness category the defect probes; the set covers `core` (the method's math) and `degeneracy` (the no-op/empty-set guards) at minimum. Verification recipe (run AFTER any background compute, so a mid-run arm never imports a mutated src): for each defect, `git stash`-clean state, apply the find->replace, run `.venv/bin/python -m pytest <must_fail> -q` and confirm it FAILS, then `git checkout -- <file>` to revert; confirm the node PASSES on clean code. Every must_fail node below was verified to fail under its defect and pass on clean code.

defects.what_it_breaks: FGSM (E1, tex:309) must perturb by eps*sign(grad); using the raw gradient makes ||eta||_inf != eps and destroys the max-norm attack.
defects.find:
J = cross_entropy_cost(model, x, y)
    g = torch.autograd.grad(J, x)[0]
    eta = eps * torch.sign(g)
    x_tilde = (x + eta).detach()
    return x_tilde
defects.replace:
J = cross_entropy_cost(model, x, y)
    g = torch.autograd.grad(J, x)[0]
    eta = eps * g
    x_tilde = (x + eta).detach()
    return x_tilde

defects.what_it_breaks: E7 at eps=0 must equal the clean cost exactly (x + 0*sign(g) == x). Adding a 1e-3 floor makes the no-op perturbation nonzero, so the method no longer reproduces the baseline at its degenerate setting.

mean_confidence_on_errors must average the predicted-class probability over the MISCLASSIFIED subset only (SPEC §6 item 14). Averaging over ALL examples silently inflates the metric when the model is mostly correct.

RBF confidence must be the UNNORMALIZED per-class exp(q_k) (SPEC §6 item 9); a softmax reading is bounded below by 1/K=0.1 and structurally cannot reproduce the paper's 1.2% / 0% (tex:600-604,923). This defect swaps in softmax, so off-manifold confidence stays >= 0.1.

E6 (tex:410-412) is the WORST-case adversarial loss (eps*||w||_1 SUBTRACTED from the activation reduces the margin). Flipping the sign makes it the BEST case (E6 < clean), contradicting the adversary.

A grader fed an EMPTY input set must RAISE, not return a vacuous 0.0 (a silent OK on an empty result is indistinguishable from the method never being applied). This defect removes the empty-input guard so eval_clean returns nan/0.0 instead of raising.
